title: Etale stalks of sheaves of sets commute with finite limits
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\bar s:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to S$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and let $F\mapsto F_{\bar s}$ be the stalk functor of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] on the category $\Sh(S_{\Et})$ of sheaves of sets on $S_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. Then this functor commutes with finite limits. In particular, for morphisms $\delta_1,\delta_2:A\to B$ of sheaves of sets on $S_{\Et}$ with equalizer $\iota:E\to A$ in $\Sh(S_{\Et})$, the map $\iota_{\bar s}:E_{\bar s}\to A_{\bar s}$ is injective and its image is $\{a\in A_{\bar s}:(\delta_1)_{\bar s}(a)=(\delta_2)_{\bar s}(a)\}$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 03PT (lemma-stalk-exact) (4): the stalk functor Sh(S_etale) -> Sets is exact, i.e. commutes with finite limits and colimits
